original: tad brahma tāvat kramānurodhena sākṣāccākṣuṣatayā mānasatayā svaprakāśasaṃvidrūpeṇa ca bhātītyarthaḥ | ayaṃ cāśayaḥ -- śrīgurupavanapurādhīśaṃ cakṣuṣā sākṣātkṛtya śravaṇakīrtanādilakṣaṇayā bhaktyā bhajatāṃ jhaṭiti sañjātayā premalakṣaṇayā bhaktyā nikhilakalmaṣanāśe sati nirmalacetastayāvilambitameva sādhanacatuṣṭayasampatteradhikāritve jāte

original: sakalalokaguroḥ śrīharereva prabhāveṇāhamakhaṇḍaṃ brahmāsmīti cittavṛttirudeti | sā ca brahmaviṣayā satī brahmagatājñānabādhanadvārā tatkāryabhūtaṃ śarīrādiprapañcaṃ, tadantarbhūtāmakhaṇḍākārāṃ cittavṛttimapi bādhate | tadā darpaṇādyabhāve bimbapratibimbaikyavat pratyagabhinnaṃ saccidānandaṃ brahma svaprakāśasaṃvidrūpeṇāvatiṣṭhata iti |

original: evamanāyāsenaiva paramapuruṣārthalabdhiḥ sukṛtaparipākaikamūletyāha -- hanta bhāgyaṃ janānāmiti | janānāṃ bhāgyaṃ puruṣārthalabdhisāmagracānumīyata ityarthaḥ | janānāmityaviśeṣoktyā sarveṣāmapi bhagavadbhajanādhikāra iti dyotyate | hanteti harṣe |
analyzed: evam anāyāsena eva parama puruṣa artha labdhiḥ sukṛta paripāka eka mūlā iti āha hanta bhāgyam janānām iti janānām bhāgyam puruṣa artha labdhi sāmagracā anumīyate iti arthaḥ janānām iti aviśeṣa uktyā sarveṣām api bhagavat bhajana adhikāraḥ iti dyotyate hanta iti harṣe

original: janānāṃ bhāgye sati harṣāvirbhāvo'sya śukanāradādibhagavadadhikāripuruṣāṇāmiva paramakāruṇikatayā parārthaghaṭanakutukitvaṃ dyotayati | nanu kimarthamidamucyate 'brahma bhāti, hanta bhāgyaṃ janānāmi'ti | na tāvat svapratipattyarthe, vākyaprayogavaiyarthyāt | na paraṃ bodhayituṃ, ‘bhajadhvaji'tyāditadupapādakavākyaśeṣāśravaṇāditi ced, maivam |
analyzed: janānām bhāgye sati harṣa āvirbhāvaḥ sya śuka nārada ādi bhagavat adhikāri puruṣāṇām iva parama kāruṇika tayā parārtha ghaṭana kutuki tvam dyotayati nanu kimartham idam ucyate brahma bhāti hanta bhāgyam janānām iti na tāvat sva pratipatti arthe vākya prayoga vaiyarthyāt na param bodhayitum bhaja dhvajityādi tad upapādaka vākyaśeṣa aśravaṇāt iti ced mā evam

original: yathā kenacillākṣaṇikena ‘nidhigarbheyaṃ bhūmiḥ, hanta bhāgyavanto yūyam' ityukte śrotārastadarthibhirnidhigrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityanenoktamityadhyāhṛtya vākyaśeṣaṃ kalpayanti, tadvadatrāpi vākyaśeṣo'dhyāhartavyaḥ |
analyzed: yathā kenacid lākṣaṇikena nidhi garbhā iyam bhūmiḥ hanta bhāgyavantaḥ yūyam iti ukte śrotāraḥ tad arthibhiḥ nidhi grahaṇam kartavyam iti anena uktam iti adhyāhṛtya vākyaśeṣam kalpayanti tadvat atra api vākyaśeṣaḥ adhyāhartavyaḥ

original: evañca kathañcid bahujanmārjitasukṛtaparipākavaśena labdhamanuṣyajanmāno yūyaṃ bhaktiyogapuraḥsaraṃ bhaktānugrahāyāṅgīkṛtasattvavigrahaṃ śrīguruvāyupuranāthaṃ paraṃ brahma saṃsevya paramapuruṣārthamanubhavatetyupadeśarahasyamevaitadityavagantavyam | nanu bhāgyamiti karmaphalamucyate |
analyzed: evam ca kathañcid bahu janma arjita sukṛta paripāka vaśena labdha manuṣya janmānaḥ yūyam bhaktiyoga puraḥsaram bhakta anugrahāya aṅgīkṛta sattva vigraham śrī guru vāyupura nātham param brahma saṃsevya paramapuruṣa artham anubhavata iti upadeśa rahasyam eva etat iti avagantavyam nanu bhāgyam iti karma phalam ucyate

original: tajjanyatve paramapuruṣārthasyānityatvaprasaṅga iti ced, na, adhikāritvasampādanenopakṣīṇatvāt karmaphalānām | taduktam 'eṣāṃ nityādīnāṃ buddhiśuddhiḥ paraṃ prayojanam' iti | brahmaṇaḥ svarūpalakṣaṇamāhasāndrānandāvabodhātmakaṃ tattvamiti | ānandaḥ sukham, avabodho jñānaṃ, sāndrau ghanībhūtau ānandāvabodhāvātmā svarūpaṃ yasya tat tathoktam |
analyzed: tad janya tve parama puruṣa arthasya anitya tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na adhikāri tva sampādanena upakṣīṇa tvāt karma phalānām tat uktam eṣām nitya ādīnām buddhi śuddhiḥ param prayojanam iti brahmaṇaḥ svarūpa lakṣaṇam āha sāndra ānanda avabodha ātmakam tattvam iti ānandaḥ sukham avabodhaḥ jñānam sāndrau ghanībhūtau ānanda avabodhau ātmā svarūpam yasya tat tathā uktam

original: ānandasya sāndratvaṃ nāma srakcandanāghupādhyanavacchinnatvam | avabodhasya ca ghaṭādiviṣayānavacchinnatvam | yaduktamabhiyuktaiḥ --
analyzed: ānandasya sāndra tvam nāma srak candana agh upādhi anavacchinna tvam avabodhasya ca ghaṭa ādi viṣaya anavacchinna tvam yat uktam abhiyuktaiḥ

original: 'yasminyasminnasti loke bodhastattadupekṣaṇe |
analyzed: yasmin yasmin asti loke bodhaḥ tad tad upekṣaṇe

original: yad bodhamātraṃ tad brahmetyevaṃ vedāntaniścayād ||
analyzed: yat bodha mātram tat brahma iti evam vedānta niścayāt

original: iti | tattvaṃ paramārthaṃ sat, sarvasyāpyātmatvena prasiddhatvāt | kasyāpi hi na nāhamasmīti pratītirudeti | evañcāhaṃpratyaya evaṃ pratyagātmatvena brahmaṇaḥ siddhatvānna tatsattve vipratipattiriti bhāvaḥ | ābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇābhyāṃ saccidānandaṃ brahmeti svarūpalakṣaṇamuktaṃ, yathā prakṛṣṭaprakāśaścandramā iti |
analyzed: iti tattvam paramārtham sat sarvasya api ātmatvena prasiddhatvāt kasya api hi na na aham asmi iti pratītiḥ udeti evam ca ahaṃpratyayaḥ evam pratyagātma tvena brahmaṇaḥ siddhatvāt na tad sattve vipratipattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ ābhyām viśeṣaṇābhyām saccidānandam brahma iti svarūpa lakṣaṇam uktam yathā prakṛṣṭa prakāśaḥ candramāḥ iti

original: nanvevaṃlakṣaṇamapi brahma nānubhavapadavīmavatarati | ata īdṛśaṃ taditi sadṛṣṭāntaṃ pradarśyatāmityāśaṅkayāha -- anupamitamiti | sajātīyasya vijātīyasya vānyasyābhāvād brahmaṇaḥ kenāpyupamānamaśakyamiti bhāvaḥ | anena ca brahmaṇo'dvitīyatvamapyarthāduktam |
analyzed: nanu evaṃlakṣaṇam api brahma na anubhava padavīm avatarati atas īdṛśam tat iti sa dṛṣṭāntam pradarśyatām iti āśaṅkayā āha anupamitam iti sajātīyasya vijātīyasya vā anyasya abhāvāt brahmaṇaḥ kena api upamānam aśakyam iti bhāvaḥ anena ca brahmaṇā dvitīya tvam api arthāt uktam

original: nanu jīveśvarayorjīvānāṃ tadupādhīnāṃ ca bhede jāgrati kathamadvitīyatvaṃ brahmaṇa iti ced, maivaṃ, bhedaprapañcasya brahmaṇyanādyavidyākalpitatvena sragbhujaṅgavanmithyātvāt| tena tāvanna sadvitīyatvam | avidyā cendrajālavidyeva svāśrayamaindrajālikamavimohayantī brahmāśritā kācidaśeṣaprapañcanirmāṇaśaktiḥ |
analyzed: nanu jīva īśvarayoḥ jīvānām tad upādhīnām ca bhede jāgrati katham advitīya tvam brahmaṇaḥ iti ced mā evam bheda prapañcasya brahmaṇi anādya vidyā kalpita tvena sraj bhujaṅga vat mithyātvāt tena tāvat na sadvitīya tvam avidyā ca indrajāla vidyā iva svāśrayam aindrajālikam a vimohayantī brahma āśritā kācid aśeṣa prapañca nirmāṇa śaktiḥ

original: śaktiśaktimatorabheda iti brahmādvaitatvasiddhiḥ | nanu jīveśvarau bhinnau viruddhadharmatvād dahanatuhinavaditi bhedānumānamastīti ced, na, ekatvaśrutismṛtibādhitaviṣayatvādasyānumānasya | nanvīśvarasya jīvaikatve saṃsāritvaṃ syād, jīvānāṃ ceśvaratve saṃsārābhāvaprasaṅga iti ced, na, vidyāvidyayorbhedādubhayopapatteḥ |
analyzed: śakti śaktimatoḥ abhedaḥ iti brahma advaita tva siddhiḥ nanu jīva īśvarau bhinnau viruddha dharma tvāt dahana tuhina vat iti bheda anumānam asti iti ced na ekatva śruti smṛti bādhita viṣaya tvāt asya anumānasya nanu īśvarasya jīva ekatve saṃsāri tvam syāt jīvānām ca īśvara tve saṃsāra abhāva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na vidyā avidyayoḥ bhedāt ubhaya upapatteḥ

original: tathāhi vidyā nāma vikṣepaśaktipradhāneśvaropādhiḥ, yayeśvaraḥ sṛṣṭyādi karoti | avidyā nāmāvaraṇaśaktipradhānā jīvopādhiḥ, yayeśvaraḥ sannapi jīvastatkṛtopādhibhedena saṃsārī bhavati | ato jīveśvarayorekatve'pyavidyayā saṃsāro vidyayā ca tadabhāvo nānupapannaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi vidyā nāma vikṣepa śakti pradhāna īśvara upādhiḥ yayā īśvaraḥ sṛṣṭi ādi karoti avidyā nāma āvaraṇa śakti pradhānā jīva upādhiḥ yayā īśvaraḥ san api jīvaḥ tad kṛta upādhi bhedena saṃsārī bhavati atas jīva īśvarayoḥ eka tve pi avidyayā saṃsāraḥ vidyayā ca tad abhāvaḥ na anupapannaḥ

original: anāditvānnirguṇatvāñceśvarasya jarāmaraṇādisāṃsārikadharmāśca na bhavanti, yathā svapnādutthitasya svāmāḥ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādaya ityalamatiprasaṅgena | nanu kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādirātmanaḥ svābhāviko dharma hāta na kadācidapi tena viyogaḥ syādityāśaṅkayāha -- kāladeśāvadhibhyāṃ nimuktamiti |
analyzed: anādi tvāt nirguṇa tvāt ca īśvarasya jarā maraṇa ādi sāṃsārika dharmāḥ ca na bhavanti yathā svapnāt utthitasya kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva ādayaḥ iti alam atiprasaṅgena nanu kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva ādiḥ ātmanaḥ svābhāvikaḥ dharma na kadācid api tena viyogaḥ syāt iti āśaṅkayā āha kāla deśa avadhibhyām iti

original: kālato yo'vadhirdeśataśca, tābhyāṃ nirmuktaṃ virahitamityarthaḥ | tataśca vyomavadamūrtasya kūṭasthasya brahmaṇaḥ kriyādisaṃyogānupapatterna kartṛtvabhoktṛttre ityarthaḥ| nityatvaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ kāryaprapañcasyotpatteḥ prāk paścādapi vidyamānatvam |
analyzed: kālataḥ yaḥ vadhiḥ deśataḥ ca tābhyām nirmuktam virahitam iti arthaḥ tatas ca vyoma vat amūrtasya kūṭasthasya brahmaṇaḥ kriyā ādi saṃyoga anupapatteḥ na kartṛ tva bhoktṛ ttre iti arthaḥ nitya tvam ca brahmaṇaḥ kārya prapañcasya utpatteḥ prāk paścāt api vidyamāna tvam

original: vibhutvaṃ ca yathā mṛtsuvarṇāderghaṭakuṇḍalādiṣūpādānakāraṇatvenānugamaḥ, tadvat sarvopādānasya brahmaṇo'pi sarvatra śarīrādau kāraṇatvenānusyūtatvāt sarvavyāptatvam | ato'nena jagatkāraṇaṃ brahmeti ayāvallakṣyabhāvi taṭasthalakṣaṇamapyarthāduktaṃ veditavyam | evaṃ lakṣaṇadvayasiddhasya vastunaḥ pramāṇāpekṣāyāmāha nigameti |
analyzed: vibhu tvam ca yathā mṛd suvarṇa ādeḥ ghaṭa kuṇḍala ādiṣu upādānakāraṇa tvena anugamaḥ tadvat sarva upādānasya brahmaṇaḥ api sarvatra śarīra ādau kāraṇa tvena anusyūta tvāt sarva vyāpta tvam atas nena jagat kāraṇam brahma iti ayāvallakṣya bhāvi taṭastha lakṣaṇam api arthāt uktam veditavyam evam lakṣaṇa dvaya siddhasya vastunaḥ pramāṇa apekṣāyām āha nigama iti

original: nigamā upaniṣadaḥ, tāsāṃ śatasahasramiti bahutvābhiprāyam | bahubhirupaniṣadvākyairityarthaḥ | aspaṣṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā nirbhāsyamānamiti, upakramopasaṃhārādibhirliṅgaistātparyeṇa lakṣaṇayā pratipādyamānamityarthaḥ | yadvā dṛṣṭamātre'spaṣṭamiti sambandhaḥ| vākyārthajñāne satyapi viparītānyathābhāvanādi dibyohavat sahasā na nivartate |

original: tata iti | tataḥ śiśupālavadhānantaraṃ sutarāṃ mahite pūjite | tvayā nirūḍhe parisamāpite śrīkṛṣṇo jayati sarvasmādutkṛṣṭo bhavati, sa īśvaro yasya vaśe sa dharmajo jayatītyālapan jano mahājanaḥ svaṃ svaṃ bhavanaṃ yayau | sa kalyaṃśaḥ suyodhanastu sapatnānāṃ śatrūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ śriyā samṛdhghā dhutam asūyādibhicalitaṃ mano yasya |
analyzed: tatas iti tatas śiśupāla vadha anantaram sutarām mahite pūjite tvayā nirūḍhe parisamāpite śrī kṛṣṇaḥ jayati sarvasmāt utkṛṣṭaḥ bhavati saḥ īśvaraḥ yasya vaśe sa dharmajaḥ jayati iti ālapan janaḥ mahājanaḥ svam svam bhavanam yayau sa kalyaṃśaḥ suyodhanaḥ tu sapatnānām śatrūṇām pāṇḍavānām śriyā dhutam asūyā ādibhiḥ calitam manaḥ yasya

original: khāṇḍavadāhe mayenārpitāyā dattāyāḥ sabhāyā mukhe sthalajalabhramāt sthaladhiyā jale patanād jaladhiyā sthale vastrāntagrahaṇācca abhramīt sambhrānto'bhūt ||10||

original: nanu vihitasya karmaṇo'nanuṣṭhānaṃ na yuktaṃ, pāpotpattau prāyaścittamapi kāryamevetyāśaṅkaya karmaṇāmavidvadadhikāritvena viduṣastadakaraṇe na doṣa ityāha nānātvāditi | manuṣyo'hamiti dehe ahamabhimāno bhrāntiḥ | tajjanyaṃ nānātvaṃ varṇāśramādibhedaḥ |
analyzed: nanu vihitasya karmaṇaḥ unanuṣṭhānam na yuktam pāpa utpattau prāyaścittam api kāryam eva iti āśaṅkaya karmaṇām avidvat adhikāri tvena viduṣaḥ tad akaraṇe na doṣaḥ iti āha nānātvāt iti manuṣyaḥ aham iti dehe aham abhimānaḥ bhrāntiḥ tad janyam nānātvam varṇa āśrama ādi bhedaḥ

original: tatsatyatāṅgīkāra eva guṇadoṣau nityanaimittikaṃ karma sattvaśodhakatvād guṇaḥ, hiṃsādi doṣaḥ, pāpakṣayasādhanatvāta kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādi guṇaḥ ityādiguṇadoṣāvabodhe satyeva vidhirvyāsedho niṣedho vā bhavet |
analyzed: tad satyatā aṅgīkāraḥ eva guṇa doṣau nitya naimittikam karma sattva śodhaka tvāt guṇaḥ hiṃsā ādi doṣaḥ pāpa kṣaya sādhana tvāt kṛcchra cāndrāyaṇa ādi guṇaḥ ityādi guṇa doṣa avabodhe sati eva vidhiḥ vyāsedhaḥ niṣedhaḥ vā bhavet

original: tvayi nihitamateḥ brahmaivedaṃ sarvamiti niścitabuddheḥ ata eva vītavaiṣamyabuddheḥ tyaktanānātvabhramasya mama tu kathaṃ tau vidhiniṣaidhau syātām | ato vidhiniṣedhānadhikārāt sarvaṃ tyaktvā careyamityarthaḥ | evañca vidhiniṣedhātīto jñānamiśrāyāṃ bhaktāvadhikārītyapi darśitam | taduktaṃ muktāphale "jñānamiśraikā bhikṣūṇām" iti || 1 ||
analyzed: tvayi nihita mateḥ brahma eva idam sarvam iti niścita buddheḥ atas eva vīta vaiṣamya buddheḥ tyakta nānātva bhramasya mama tu katham tau vidhi niṣaidhau syātām atas vidhi niṣedha anadhikārāt sarvam tyaktvā careyam iti arthaḥ evam ca vidhi niṣedha atītaḥ jñāna miśrāyām bhaktau adhikārī iti api darśitam tat uktam muktāphale jñāna miśrā ekā bhikṣūṇām iti

original: etat sarva puruṣaśarīreṇaiva sādhyamiti vaktuṃ tiryagādidehebhyaḥ puruṣatanurutkṛṣṭeti puruṣatvaṃ stauti --

original: tatrāpyātmātmanaḥ syāt suhṛdapi ca ripuryastvayi nyastacetāsvāpocchinterupācaṃ smarati sa hi suhṛt svātmavairī tato'nyaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: tatra api ātmā ātmanaḥ syāt suhṛd api ca ripuḥ yaḥ tvayi nyasta cetāḥ svāpa ucchinteḥ upācam smarati sa hi suhṛd sva ātma vairī tatonyaḥ

original: kṣuttṛṣṇeti | kṣuttṛṣṇayoḥ aśanāyāpipāsayoḥ lopaḥ tṛṇakavalanajalapānādi etāvanmātre satataṃ kṛtadhiyo niścitabuddhayaḥ jantavaḥ paśvādayaḥ anantāḥ bahavaḥ santi tebhyaḥ vijñānavattvād ātmadarśanasāmarthyena iha bhūmau puruṣo manuṣyaḥ varaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ | tajjanirmanuṣyajanma | tatrāpi manuṣyeṣvapi ātmaivātmanaḥ suhṛd upakārī ripuḥ apakārī ca |
analyzed: kṣudh tṛṣṇā iti kṣudh tṛṣṇayoḥ aśanāyā pipāsayoḥ lopaḥ tṛṇa kavalana jala pāna ādi etāvat mātre satatam kṛtadhiyaḥ niścita buddhayaḥ jantavaḥ paśu ādayaḥ anantāḥ bahavaḥ santi tebhyaḥ vijñānavat tvāt ātma darśana sāmarthyena iha bhūmau puruṣaḥ manuṣyaḥ varaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ tad janiḥ manuṣya janma tatra api manuṣyeṣu api ātmā eva ātmanaḥ suhṛd upakārī ripuḥ apakārī ca

original: vivekamāha -- yastvayi nyastacetāḥ ata eva tāpocchitteḥ mokṣasya upāyaṃ sādhanaṃ smarati jānāti, tathāvidhaśvedātmā svayameva ātmanaḥ svasya suhṛd bandhuḥ syāt | tato'nyaḥ naivaṃvidhaḥ sa ātmavairī ātmahā ||2||
analyzed: vivekam āha yaḥ tvayi nyasta cetāḥ atas eva tāpa ucchitteḥ mokṣasya upāyam sādhanam smarati jānāti tathāvidhaḥ ced ātmā svayam eva ātmanaḥ svasya suhṛd bandhuḥ syāt tatonyaḥ na evaṃvidhaḥ saḥ ātma vairī ātma hā 2

original: nanbātmaivātmano gururityuktaṃ tadasaṅgatamityāśaṅkaya yad yasyājñānanāśahetuḥ sa tasya gururitīha vivakṣitatvāt sthiracarāṇāmapi taddhetutvād gurutvamūrīkaraṇīyaṃ, kiṃ punarātmana iti pariharan pṛthivyādibhyo gurubhyaḥ śikṣaṇīyāni kṣamādīnyātmanaḥ prārthayate --
analyzed: nanu ātmā eva ātmanaḥ guruḥ iti uktam tat asaṅgatam iti āśaṅkaya yat yasya ajñāna nāśa hetuḥ sa tasya guruḥ iti iha vivakṣita tvāt sthira carāṇām api tad hetu tvāt gurutvam ūrīkaraṇīyam kim punar ātmanaḥ iti pariharan pṛthivī ādibhyaḥ gurubhyaḥ śikṣaṇīyāni kṣamā ādīni ātmanaḥ prārthayate

original: tvatkāruṇye pravṛtte ka iva na hi gururlokavṛtte'pi bhūman !

original: sarvākrāntāpi bhūmirna hi calati tataḥ satkṣamāṃ śikṣayeyam |
analyzed: sarva ākrāntā api bhūmiḥ na hi calati tatas sat kṣamām śikṣayeyam

original: gṛhṇīyāmīśa! tattadviṣayaparicaye'pyaprasaktiṃ samīrād

original: vyāptatvaṃ cātmano me gaganagurubaśād bhātu nirlepatā ca || 3 ||
analyzed: vyāpta tvam ca ātmanaḥ me gagana guru baśāt bhātu nirlepa tā ca

original: tvatkāruṇya iti | ka iva nahi guruḥ, na kevalamātmaiva, pṛthivyādipadārthā api gurava eveti bhāvaḥ | kimebhyaḥ śikṣaṇīyaṃ, tadāha -- lokavṛtta iti | lokāḥ sthiracarādayaḥ teṣāṃ vṛttaṃ kṣamānissaṅgatvālepakatvādisvabhāvaḥ | tatraite gurava ityarthaḥ | he vibhūman ! viṣṇo! bhūmiḥ sarvaiḥ khalairākrāntāpi na calati hi |
analyzed: tvad kāruṇye iti kaḥ iva nahi guruḥ na kevalam ātmā eva pṛthivī ādi padārthāḥ api guravaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ kim ebhyaḥ śikṣaṇīyam tat āha loka vṛttaḥ iti lokāḥ sthira cara ādayaḥ teṣām vṛttam kṣamā nissaṅga tva ālepaka tva ādi svabhāvaḥ tatra ete guravaḥ iti arthaḥ he vibhūman viṣṇo bhūmiḥ sarvaiḥ khalaiḥ ākrāntā api na calati hi

original: tataḥ bhūmeḥ satkṣamāṃ svamārgādacalanarūpāṃ śikṣayeyaṃ kartavyatayāvagaccheyam | tattadviṣayairguṇavadbhirdoṣavadbhiśca paricaye samparke satyapyaprasaktim asaṅgatvaṃ samīrād gṛhṇīyāṃ śikṣayeyam | ātmanaḥ śarīraparicchinnatayā pratīyamānasya vyāptatvaṃ sarvaśarīreṣvantarbahiśca vyāptatvam | me gaganaguruvaśāditi |
analyzed: tatas bhūmeḥ sat kṣamām sva mārgāt acalana rūpām śikṣayeyam kartavya tayā avagaccheyam tad tad viṣayaiḥ guṇavadbhiḥ doṣavadbhiḥ ca paricaye samparke sati api aprasaktim asaṅga tvam samīrāt gṛhṇīyām śikṣayeyam ātmanaḥ śarīra paricchinna tayā pratīyamānasya vyāpta tvam sarva śarīreṣu antar bahis ca vyāpta tvam me gagana guru vaśāt iti

original: gaganaṃ hi ghaṭādiparicchinnatayā pratīyamānamapi rbāherantaśca vyāptam | kiñca, nirlepatā śarīrasthatve'pi tatsparśarahito nirlepaḥ, tasya bhāvo nirlepatā | sā ca gaganaguruvaśādeva me bhātu | yathā gaganaṃ meghādibhirna spṛśyate tatheti || 3 ||
analyzed: gaganam hi ghaṭa ādi paricchinna tayā pratīyamānam api rbāheḥ antar ca vyāptam kiñca nirlepa tā śarīra stha tve pi tad sparśa rahitaḥ nirlepaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ nirlepa tā sā ca gagana guru vaśāt eva me bhātu yathā gaganam megha ādibhiḥ na spṛśyate tathā iti
